We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template (ID 1679747) to the molecule given: initial_molecule SMILES: C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2

We have template info from previous step: mapped_rxn is a reaction SMARTS? It shows forward reaction? The mapped_rxn: "O=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][c:6]([O:7][CH3:8])[cH:9][cH:10]1)[c:11]1[cH:12][cH:13][c:14]([O:15][CH3:16])[cH:17][cH:18]1.[Li][CH2:1][Si](C)(C)C>>[CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][c:6]([O:7][CH3:8])[cH:9][cH:10]1)[c:11]1[cH:12][cH:13][c:14]([O:15][CH3:16])[cH:17][cH:18]1"

So template is a reaction where a LiCH2Si(C)(C)C (some silyl reagent) reacts with a carbonyl? Actually forward reaction: O=[C:2]... + LiCH2Si... -> product with CH2= C etc. This is a Wittig-type? Actually looks like a Wittig olefination: aldehyde/ketone + ylide gives alkene.

Thus retrosynthetic template would break the C=C double bond to give carbonyl and ylide precursor.

Our target molecule is C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2. That's a stilbene derivative with two anisole rings (methoxy phenyl). The double bond is between two aryl groups, each with OMe substituent.

Applying the template likely will break the C=C double bond to give a carbonyl (aldehyde/ketone) and a ylide (LiCH2Si...). The product is a substituted alkene with CH2 attached to carbonyl carbon? Wait product SMILES: [CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]... )... So product is a vinyl with CH2 attached to carbonyl carbon? Actually [CH2]=[C] where C is carbonyl carbon? The template shows O=[C:2]... (a carbonyl) reacting with LiCH2Si... to give CH2= C (alkene) attached to aromatic groups.

Thus retrosynthesis: target alkene -> precursors: carbonyl (aldehyde/ketone) with same aromatic groups, and LiCH2Si(C)(C)C (the ylide). The carbonyl would be O= C attached to the two aromatic groups? Wait product is CH2= C(Ar1)(Ar2). The carbonyl precursor would be O= C(Ar1)(Ar2) i.e., a diaryl ketone? Actually carbonyl carbon attached to two aryl groups: O=C(Ar1)(Ar2). That's a diaryl ketone (benzophenone type). Our target is C=C(Ar1)Ar2 (stilbene). So retrosynthesis: benzophenone + LiCH2Si(C)(C)C.

Thus we need to apply template to target molecule to get precursors list. Use apply_template tool with molecule SMILES and template_id "template_1679747"? The ID format maybe "template_1679747". The earlier answer gave template_id numeric 1679747. The tool expects string like "template_123". So we should use "template_1679747". Let's try.
